description: This source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application written in Kotlin. It sets up the main activity UI, retrieves a message, splits it into tokens, joins those tokens into a string, and capitalizes the result before displaying it in a TextView.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that initializes UI, processes a message, and displays the result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. It sets the UI content and initializes the TextView with a processed message.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Builds a message by splitting, joining, and capitalizing a message string.
